name: SplitText-TS-TW
title: SplitText
description: A heading and a smaller line split into individual characters or words, then fade and lift into position in sequence as they enter the viewport. A replay button restarts the entrance.
use: A hero or section heading should arrive with a crafted, sequential reveal as it scrolls into view.
avoid: It needs GSAP and ScrollTrigger and starts hidden, so a failed script can leave the heading unseen.
a11y: The text reads normally to assistive tech, but the entrance ignores reduced motion and is invisible until the script runs. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A large white bold headline reading "Every letter has a story." sits above a smaller grey line, both centred on black, with a tiny outlined Replay control at the lower right. Mid-animation the same words show with letters missing and blurred edges.
behaves: When the text scrolls into view each letter, or word, lifts and fades in with a short stagger from first to last. The replay control reruns the sequence, and the scroll trigger only fires once.
customise: Set text, tag, splitType (chars, words, lines, words and chars), delay, duration, ease, from and to tween values, threshold, rootMargin and an onComplete callback.
weight: light: One GSAP timeline per text block that runs once and then idles.
